Text: Agent Versioning and Rollback Strategy

Agents change frequently. Without proper versioning and fast rollback, a bad update can affect many users for hours.

As a dev, I now treat agent versions with the same discipline as regular services.

Agent Versioning Cheatsheet:
1. Version prompts, tools, and orchestration logic together
2. Keep previous versions runnable
3. Use canary or percentage-based rollouts
4. Monitor quality and cost per version
5. Support one-click or automatic rollback
6. Document what changed in each version

Core principle: If you cannot roll back an agent version in under 5 minutes, your release process is incomplete.

Pro tip: Version the entire agent configuration, not just the prompt.
